source_evidence: Exact player 'Viscount Valenthia of House Vaishnavi. And I believe your Lady’s pending claim will be denied soon, for I am back.' V openly identifies himself to the three road collectors and states his expectation of defeating Caul's competing claim. Collector's composure briefly falters; he exchanges a glance with companion and queries the assertion of return. He becomes careful about rival noble authority, reiterates Lady Caul's old-charter claim, speculates she would be interested in meeting a superior claimant, but says he has no orders suspending collections. This is the actual local patrol's reaction and knowledge of V's stated name/title/claim, not proof of personal lineage, validated authority, knowledge of V's ancient identity, a confirmed pending Crown adjudication, an invitation from Caul herself, actual message/report, or automatic surrender. No other faction actor is informed by this dialogue. The female resident appeals to V for help getting their grain through without unlawful dues; exemption document remains available but uninspected, goods and positions unchanged. No persuasion/intimidation check because V has not requested a specific concession or command in this turn; no attack, movement, payment, seizure result, new quest acceptance or resource/time expenditure beyond immediate conversation. Day333~11:33, next V choice.
